attributes.name: environment
attributes.purpose: Resolve an environment spec: (EnvModel carrying the installed adapters' product roles (core.environment.product_roles / with_product_roles, attached before the applicable adapters are chosen, so a kit's applies finds its products), with required roles applied and what its kits answer for cluster discovery (with_cluster_discovery over the applicable adapters), the applicable adapters).

attributes.name: check_ping_devops
attributes.purpose: Planner check on the target: actions for PingFederate licenses, the admin password, admin console replicas, engines without their admin console, workloads beyond one per product, and a rendered server profile's OPSDIR_* variables the record doesn't deliver (unmapped_variables); ok 'has its licenses and admin password recorded' when none. Cluster discovery is PingFederate's check_kit_discovery over this kit's cluster_discovery declaration.

attributes.name: recorded_query
attributes.purpose: ping-devops: the DNS name environment m's PingFederate cluster-discovery binding (role from roles_for(PingFederate, cluster-discovery)) has its nodes query when it uses DNS_PING (stated, or no protocol, no storage reference and a ciamFqdn), else None: the values' DNS_QUERY_LOCATION. Repeats PingFederate's binding_protocol rule (source of truth; the showcase test test_cluster_discovery_rule checks they agree).

attributes.name: discovery_gap
attributes.purpose: PingFederate (moved from ping-devops, task 520): (finding text, Fix) when environment m's pf-cluster-discovery binding doesn't have the nodes find each other by DNS_PING through the name a deployment kit's chart answers in a namespace (a contract.DiscoveryAnswer), else None. Text 'PingFederate runs on Kubernetes in <env> (namespace `<ns>`): ... Record that binding.'; Fix '<kit>-discovery:<env>:<ns>' (area PingFederate on Kubernetes) binding DNS_PING through the name (discovery_records), its step installing the kit's values (they set the answer's setting from the binding).

attributes.name: with_cluster_discovery
attributes.purpose: The same environment carrying what the deployment kits among the adapters rendering it answer for their products' cluster discovery: each adapter's cluster_discovery(as_seen(m)) concatenated into EnvModel.cluster_discovery (DiscoveryAnswers), for a product's own check (discovery_answers).

attributes.name: discovery_answers
attributes.purpose: The DiscoveryAnswers the kits rendering environment m give for a product's cluster discovery (m.cluster_discovery filtered by product), in their order; () when none deploys it.

attributes.name: cluster_discovery
attributes.purpose: ping-devops (Adapter.cluster_discovery): what the chart answers for PingFederate's cluster discovery in environment m: per placement namespace a DiscoveryAnswer(PingFederate, namespace, release.cluster_query(namespace), 'ping-devops', DNS_QUERY_LOCATION).

attributes.name: recorded_query
attributes.purpose: PingFederate: the DNS name environment m's pf-cluster-discovery binding has its nodes query when its protocol (binding_protocol) is DNS_PING, else None.

attributes.name: check_kit_discovery
attributes.purpose: PingFederate planner check (first of its checks): where a deployment kit deploys PingFederate (discovery_answers(m, PingFederate)), an action (area PingFederate on Kubernetes, owner the environment's responsible) and fix (discovery_gap) per namespace whose chart answers a DNS name the record's discovery binding doesn't query by DNS_PING; an ok line per namespace when all agree; nothing without answers.
